heading: About Me
bio: I'm a Machine Learning Engineer with 3+ years of experience building and deploying AI/ML solutions across automotive, enterprise consulting, and manufacturing. At Lucid Motors, I develop computer vision and predictive models for autonomous driving, improving detection accuracy by 25% and enabling sub-100ms inference on production vehicle platforms. Before that, at TCS, I delivered end-to-end ML for enterprise clients, including predictive maintenance, demand forecasting, and NLP automation, and cut model deployment time by 40% with MLOps pipelines. I started at Mahindra & Mahindra, building software and analytics for automotive manufacturing that reduced manual effort by 35%. I work mostly in Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, SQL, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, and Airflow, with hands-on experience in CNNs, LSTMs, Transformers, RAG pipelines, and LLM integration.
